description: A shell script for self-healing connectivity tests, including DNS and ping tests, with mechanisms to reset the router and perform corrective actions based on test results.

methods.name: getCorrectiveActionState
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of the corrective action setting.

methods.name: calcRandTimetoStartPing
methods.description: Calculates a random delay before starting the ping test.

methods.name: resetRouter
methods.description: Reboots the router by invoking a simulated device reboot.

methods.name: resetNeeded
methods.description: Performs a reset if the process is PING.

methods.name: runDNSPingTest
methods.description: Performs a DNS ping test and takes corrective action if DNS resolution fails.

methods.name: runPingTest
methods.description: Performs a ping test to the default gateway and triggers a reset if ping fails.
